jobs.title: CAD and Methodology Engineer, Silicon
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a lead CAD and methodology engineer to shape the methodology, EDA, and PDK infrastructure for our AMS custom silicon programs. While supporting AMS design, signal integrity and power integrity, and packaging engineers, you will define and own the CAD flows, PDK deployment, and EDA tool environment. You will support all custom silicon AMS environments across Meta, while building automation frameworks and integrating AI-assisted design tools to accelerate engineering velocity across the silicon team.  
  
  

### **CAD and Methodology Engineer, Silicon Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain analog/mixed-signal, signal integrity and power integrity, and packaging simulation flow and methodology across various technology nodes
* Collaborate with foundries in installing, maintaining, and updating on-premise PDK implementations
* Integrate AI and LLM-assisted coding tools into CAD methodology to improve design automation productivity across the silicon engineering organization
* Drive and collaborate with EDA tool vendors to evaluate CAD tools/products, validate simulation flows, and enhance the custom design environment
* Provide technical direction to other engineers on CAD methodology decisions, flow architecture, and implementation best practices across all the AMS programs
* Communicate implementation status, methodology decisions, and risk assessments to circuit designers, layout engineers, and program leaders

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of industry experience in CAD, PDK, and silicon design methodology across multiple technology nodes and products
* Proven industry experience in analog CAD/automation support areas involving various technology nodes and tapeouts
* Proficiency in analog/mixed-signal design environment and simulation tools
* Experience diagnosing and resolving convergence, accuracy, and simulation speed issues in analog/mixed-signal environments
* Proficiency in debugging and maintaining high-quality AI scripting artifacts in languages such as SKILL, Python, and Perl, etc
* Experience communicating methodology decisions, risk assessments, and implementation status to cross-functional partners and external partners such as foundry contacts

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools or LLM-based coding assistants applied to CAD automation or implementation flow development

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Bioinformatics Scientist II
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call *the Veracyte way* – it's about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

* **We Seek A Better Way**: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
* **We Make It Happen**: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
* **We Are Stronger Together**: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
* **We Care Deeply**: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

### **The Position:**

We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development**

* Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.
* Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.
* Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.
* Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.
* Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.
* Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

### **Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving**

* Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.
* Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.
* Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.
* Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.
* Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.
* Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

### **Quality & Documentation**

* Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.
* Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.
* Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

### **Who You Are:**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.
* Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.
* Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.
* Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
* Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.
* Demonstrated scientific curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting development of NGS-based research or diagnostic assays.
* Familiarity with cancer genomics, somatic variant analysis, and liquid biopsy applications.
* Experience working with cell-free DNA (cfDNA) or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) datasets.
* Knowledge of bioinformatics best practices, reproducible research methods, and software version control tools.
* Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
* Exposure to regulated product development environments, including CAP/CLIA, FDA, or IVD development processes.
* Experience collaborating closely with both laboratory and computational scientists.

---------------------------

* Demonstrates strong scientific judgment and analytical rigor.
* Develops a deep understanding of assay biology, experimental design, and data interpretation.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician I (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Laboratory Technician I (Part-Time)

**Eurofins Microbiology Laboratories, Inc. (EML)**  
**Location:** 2841 Dow Ave., Suite 400, Tustin, CA 92780  
**Pay Range:** $18.00–$22.00 per hour, depending on experience (DOE)  
**Employment Type:** Part-Time, Flexible Schedule Monday-Sunday 11-19:30 or 13:30-20:00

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job Description

Eurofins Microbiology Laboratories is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Part-Time Laboratory Technician I to join our microbiology team in Tustin, California.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone interested in developing a career in laboratory science and food microbiology.

The Laboratory Technician I performs routine microbiological testing on food and environmental samples while following established laboratory procedures and quality standards.

Responsibilities include preparing samples, performing microbiological plating, assisting with bacterial enumeration, reading plates, maintaining laboratory supplies, and accurately documenting testing activities.

The ideal candidate is dependable, organized, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and willing to learn new laboratory techniques.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

* Prepare food and environmental samples for microbiological testing.
* Weigh, dilute, and process samples according to established laboratory procedures.
* Perform microbiological plating and inoculation procedures.
* Assist with bacterial enumeration and routine microbiological testing.
* Read and record microbiological plate results.
* Prepare culture media, reagents, and laboratory materials.
* Operate basic laboratory equipment and maintain testing supplies.
* Accurately document laboratory activities and analytical results.
* Enter sample information and results into laboratory computer systems.
* Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and testing methods.
* Perform routine quality control activities as assigned.
* Maintain clean glassware, equipment, and laboratory workspaces.
* Follow all laboratory safety procedures and applicable quality requirements.
* Communicate testing concerns or unusual observations to laboratory leadership.
* Work collaboratively with other laboratory personnel to meet daily testing requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required:

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Basic computer skills.
* Ability to follow written procedures and detailed instructions.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage assigned responsibilities.
* Dependable attendance and punctuality.

Preferred:

* Associate degree or coursework in Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Food Science, or a related scientific field.
* Previous laboratory experience.
* Familiarity with microbiological techniques, including plating, pipetting, dilutions, and sample preparation.
* Previous experience in food testing or quality control.

What We Offer

* Competitive pay of $18–$22 per hour, depending on experience.
* Hands-on experience in food microbiology and laboratory testing.
* Opportunity to develop technical laboratory skills.
* Potential for professional growth within a global scientific organization.
* This position can convert to **Full Time** after 90 days with full benefits

Equal Employment Opportunity

Eurofins USA Food Testing is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, including Disabled and Veterans.

All applicant information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Research Associate II - Surgery
jobs.description:
**Description**

The candidate will work as a full-time Staff Research Associate II (SRA II) in a cutting-edge regenerative medicine research laboratory under the mentorship of Dr. Gerald Lipshutz.

More specifically, the SRA II will primarily work on a mouse model of metabolic disease, using a gene therapy treatment to correct the abnormality and analysis of organs, blood and tissues for expression levels. The candidate will perform a variety of routine experimental protocols and procedures at a fully operational level, including but not limited to, animal experiments, use of human specimens, cell and tissue culture, DNA/RNA/genomic DNA extraction, ELISA and western blots. The SRA II will also take on a significant portion of the lab management duties, including supply management, ordering, and equipment maintenance and calibration. The candidate will also coordinate and assist with general lab support activities (e.g. making common lab reagents). The SRA II candidate will have some supervisory responsibilities as the day-to-day manager of the undergraduate students and other part-time members of the Lipshutz Lab.

The full hourly salary range for this position is $32.79 - $52.75. The department’s target hourly rate is $34.81.

  
Pay range: $32.79 - $52.75 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Ability to use computer software for word processing, data tabulation and graphing.
* Ability and knowledge to operate basic laboratory equipment, i.e. centrifuge, tissue culture hood and related equipment, autoclaving, weighing, pipetting microliter volumes, etc.
* Ability and working knowledge of DNA, RNA, protein purification and quantification; PCR, qPCR, Western Blot.
* Excellent communication skills to interact with other researchers, vendors, suppliers, and maintenance engineers.
* Exceptional organizational and recordkeeping skills.
* Ability to perform tasks accurately and in a timely manner working independently under the program guidelines and under frequent changes in priorities and deadlines
* Knowledge and ability to order supplies and maintain laboratory equipment.
* Bachelor of Science degree life/biomedical science discipline, or equivalent experience
* Ability to generate hypotheses, suggest experimental designs, interpret data and recognize aberrant results.

**Preferred:**

* Working knowledge and experience in general immunology, cell biology and molecular and biology techniques.
* Ability to handle mice.
* Knowledge of cell culture and sterile techniques.
* Prior experience in oncology biomedical research.

jobs.title: Lab Assistant-Clinical Lab
jobs.description:
Overview:

At Sherman Oaks Hospital, our dedicated team of professionals are committed to our core values of quality, compassion, and community. As a member of the Prime Healthcare Foundation, Sherman Oaks Hospital is actively seeking new members to join its award-winning team!  
  
Sherman Oaks Hospital is a 153-bed, not-for-profit, acute-care community hospital located in Sherman Oaks, California. Staffed with over 500 employees and an extraordinary team of physicians, the hospital is recognized for advanced technology and compassionate care and provides 24/7 emergency care in addition to a full range of specialized medical, surgical, and diagnostic services to improve and save lives. Sherman Oaks Hospital has been nationally recognized multiple times as a "100 Top Hospital" by Fortune/Merative, holds an "A" grade in patient safety from The Leapfrog Group, Patient Safety Excellence recognition from Healthgrades, and more. For more information, visit www.shermanoakshospital.org.

  
Responsibilities:

The Laboratory Assistant will follow the guidelines set by CLIA, and the California Business and Professions Code Sections 1212 and 1269. Unlicensed laboratory personnel (“aides”) are limited to pre-analytical and supportive functions only and may not read, record, result, verify, or interpret any laboratory test. They may not perform any test involving the quantitative measurement of specimens or reagents, conduct mathematical calculations related to test results, perform instrument calibration, or monitor or interpret quality control data used to assess test system performance. Unlicensed personnel shall not participate in any phase of testing that involves result generation, interpretation, verification, or reporting.

All duties must be performed under the direct and constant supervision of a physician and surgeon or a licensed laboratory professional, as defined by California regulations.

Unlicensed laboratory personnel may perform approved activities including specimen collection (patient preparation, labeling, handling, processing, preservation, transportation, and storage), assisting licensed personnel, preparing and storing reagents and culture media, assisting with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (without calibration or performance verification), and supporting quality control procedures (without interpretation of results). Specimen collection involving venipuncture or skin puncture may only be performed if the individual holds appropriate California phlebotomy certification (e.g., CPT I or CPT II) or other qualifying license, as required by law.

This individual: 1) Performs computer entry, filing, telephone communication, and other clerical duties. 2) Demonstrates professional telephone etiquette and greets patients and visitors courteously. 3) Possesses effective verbal and written communication skills. 4) Demonstrates knowledge of laboratory test terminology. 5) Demonstrates knowledge of phlebotomy practices; performs venipuncture or skin puncture only if appropriately certified per California law. 6) Processes specimens across laboratory departments including pathology, microbiology, immunology, hematology, coagulation, urinalysis, chemistry, and blood bank limited to pre-analytical activities (e.g., specimen handling and centrifugation only in immunohematology). 7) Prepares and processes specimens for reference laboratories. 8) Stocks and orders routine supplies. 9) Maintains cleanliness and organization of storage areas, equipment, centrifuges, and collection sites. 10) Processes and places specimens on laboratory instruments for automated analysis only, without performing test setup, calibration, validation, or result review. 11) With documented training, may assist with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (excluding calibration and performance verification), assist in quality control procedures (without interpreting results), and perform permitted microbiology support tasks such as primary culture inoculation, slide staining, and subculturing. 12) Performs additional duties assigned by department leadership, including clerical support, communication tasks, specimen transport, and interdepartmental deliveries. 13) Assists Pathology with pre-analytical and clerical tasks only, including specimen receipt, accessioning, labeling, transport, and storage, under direct supervision and within regulatory limitations. 14) Functions as a runner to support laboratory workflow and specimen movement as needed.

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING**

  

* HS Diploma or equivalent required.
* Active California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I or II license required for individuals performing phlebotomy.
* Current BCLS (AHA) certificate upon hire and maintain current preferred.
* BLS certification within forty-five days of hire and maintained current, according to hospital requirement.
* Minimum of 1 year clinical laboratory experience performing similar job functions preferred.

Pay Transparency:

Sherman Oaks Hospital offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. A reasonable compensation estimate for this role, which includes estimated wages, benefits, and other forms of compensation, is $23.00 to $27.83. jobs.title: Research Associate, Microfluidics & Cell Culture
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory is hiring a **Research Associate, Microfluidics & Cell Culture** within the Molecular Foundry division. This position will support the development of a vascularized lung-on-a-chip platform. The position combines microfluidic device fabrication, mammalian cell culture, fluorescence imaging, and biological assays in a collaborative scientific research environment. Working under supervisory guidance, the selected candidate will contribute to experimental reliability and reproducibility while gaining experience with specialized technologies that connect bioengineering, microfabrication, and cell biology.

**You will:**

* **Microfluidic Device Fabrication:** Fabricate, assemble, and refine microfluidic devices using techniques such as PDMS soft lithography, surface treatment, and device bonding. Prepare and maintain the materials and equipment needed for fabrication, monitor experimental conditions, and communicate technical issues or unexpected results to the supervising researcher.
* **Mammalian Cell Culture:** Culture and maintain mammalian cell lines and primary cells, including seeding and maintaining cells within microfluidic devices using perfusion and flow-based culture techniques. Prepare and sterilize culture materials and reagents, monitor cell health and experimental conditions, and identify deviations from established protocols.
* **Fluorescence Imaging and Analysis:** Perform fluorescence and live-cell imaging, including sample preparation, image acquisition, and analysis. Organize, label, and analyze imaging data to support accurate interpretation, consistency, and traceability of experimental results.
* **Biological Assays:** Conduct routine biological assays, including cell viability and cytotoxicity testing, immunofluorescence, ELISA, and protein analysis. Prepare necessary reagents and materials, follow established protocols, and assist with data collection, organization, and analysis to ensure reliable and reproducible results.
* **Laboratory Operations and Collaboration:** Participate in research group meetings, maintain accurate and detailed laboratory notebooks and experimental records, and assist with maintaining laboratory equipment, supplies, and safe laboratory practices. Document experimental observations, communicate unexpected results or technical concerns to supervising researchers, and support consistent and reproducible laboratory procedures.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent knowledge/training, in Biology, Bioengineering, Neuroscience, or a related field and a minimum of 1 year of related laboratory experience.
* Basic knowledge of mammalian cell culture, including aseptic technique, passaging, cryopreservation, and transfection.
* Familiarity with fluorescence microscopy, including sample preparation, image acquisition, and basic image analysis.
* Familiarity performing standard biological assays and analyzing experimental data.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google applications.
* Strong oral and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative research environment.
* Ability to follow detailed experimental protocols, maintain aseptic conditions, and consistently document laboratory procedures and results.
* Demonstrated ability to perform laboratory experiments carefully and reproducibly, recognize unexpected results, and seek supervisory guidance when appropriate.

  

**Desired skills/knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience with microfluidic device fabrication, assembly, or operation, including PDMS soft lithography, surface treatments, and device bonding.
* Experience with scientific data analysis, including generating graphs, organizing datasets, and performing basic statistical analysis.
* Familiarity with flow cytometry for cell analysis and separation, with hands-on experience in sample preparation, instrument operation, or data analysis preferred.
* Familiarity with CAD software for microfluidic device design or layout.
* Hands-on experience with flow cytometry, including sample preparation, instrument operation, or data analysis.

  

**Additional information:**

* **Application date:** Priority consideration will be given to candidates who apply by December 4, 2026. Applications will be accepted until the job posting is removed.
* **Appointment type:** This is a part-time, 20 hours per week, term appointment through September 30, 2028, non-exempt (hourly paid), eligible for overtime pay, with the possibility of extension or conversion to Career appointment based upon satisfactory job performance, continuing availability of funds and ongoing operational needs.
* **Salary range:** The expected hourly range for this position is $28.78 - $36.69, which fits into the full hourly range of $28.78 - $44.59 depending upon the candidate's skills, knowledge, and abilities. This includes education, certifications, and years of experience.
* **Union Represented:** This position is represented by a union for collective bargaining purposes.
* **Background check:** This position is subject to a background check. Any convictions will be evaluated to determine if they directly relate to the responsibilities and requirements of the position. Having a conviction history will not automatically disqualify an applicant from being considered for employment.
* **Work modality:** Work will be primarily performed atLawrence Berkeley National Lab, 1 Cyclotron Road, Berkeley, CA. A REAL ID or other acceptable form of identification is required to access Berkeley Lab sites (for more information ).
* **Work authorization:** Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

We are looking for individuals who would like to establish a career in healthcare working with nationally recognized physicians. We provide on the job training giving you the ability to grow and advance your skills along with gaining innovative knowledge. Established in 1977, we have locations all over Northern California including Sacramento, Grass Valley, Roseville, Stockton, Modesto, Merced, Fairfield, Elk Grove, Folsom, Yuba City and Chico. Our physicians are nationally known, and we continue to be on the leading edge of retina care by utilizing the latest equipment and both participating in and designing new clinical trials to advance the state of care for retinal diseases. Join 250+ other team members working for our nationally recognized retina specialty practice in a fast paced, high volume medical office. We are currently participating in several trials at two of our office locations and have a growing clinical research department.

The research assistant is primarily responsible for assisting in research patient visits according to ICH-GCP guidelines and according to the IRB-approved study protocol and/or manual of procedures. Day-to-day activities may include all or some of the essential functions listed below, depending upon individual experience / knowledge and the needs of the organization which are subject to change from time to time.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  
  
To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

ULAR (University Laboratory Animal Resources) is an AAALAC-accredited animal care program that supports the University of California Irvine's research and teaching missions by providing high quality, humane care for vertebrate laboratory animals, in accordance with State and Federal laws and regulations pertaining to the use of animals in research and teaching.

  
Responsibilities:

The Transgenic Mouse Facility (TMF) seeks a skilled microinjectionist to produce genetically engineered mouse models. Under the supervision of TMF managing director, the core function of the role is pronuclear microinjection of DNA and CRISPR RNP into mouse zygotes, complemented by zygote electroporation, ES cell–blastocyst injection, embryo culture and assessment, and surgical embryo transfer. The incumbent manages the microinjection workflow and schedule, and independently troubleshoots and optimizes parameters for difficult constructs, low-efficiency strains, and novel transgenesis approaches, adapting standard protocols where established methods fall short. The incumbent also serves as the primary technical resource for the facility’s assisted reproductive technology (ART) services, including sperm and embryo cryopreservation, in vitro fertilization (IVF), and reagent quality control, resolving technical and procedural issues with minimal oversight. The role also involves using the scientific literature to establish best practices and effective rederivation methods for strains received from other institutions. Throughout, the incumbent keeps accurate procedure records and strain data sheets, prepares client reports that interpret embryo development and experimental outcomes, and communicates clearly with clients and the supervisor. Additional responsibilities include supporting the TMF husbandry workflow and training staff in microinjection, embryo transfer, and surgical techniques.

In addition to the salary range listed below, we offer a wealth of benefits to make working at UCI even more rewarding. * Experience in mouse reproductive biology, and handling and breeding of genetically modified mice, including administration of hormones etc via injection.

* Strong work ethic
* Experience working in a team setting

* Knowledge of mouse genetics and nomenclature, and reproductive physiology
* Ability to read and apply current scientific literature to evaluate and adapt microinjection, cryopreservation, and IVF techniques for new applications
* Bachelor of Science degree
* 3-5 yearsexperience demonstrating expertise in the relevant specialization
* A minimum of 3 years of experiencein microinjection of mouse oocytes or zygotes, with ability and experience performing precise, delicate manipulations under a microscope

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING**

  

* High School Diploma, or equivalent, required.
* Completion of a formal phlebotomy training program or equivalent on-the-job training with documented competency required.
* Active California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I license required.
* BLS certification within forty-five days of hire and maintained current, according to hospital requirement.
* Minimum of one year of clinical laboratory experience, preferred.
